name: Mahdi Translate 5.0 — instant Google-style translator
description: Focused instant translator inspired by Google Translate: instant text translation while typing, voice input (native Android speech plugin with Web Speech fallback), camera and image OCR translation with an on-device Tesseract fallback, a draggable floating translation window, offline dictionary mode, saved history and favourites, 1544 themes, PWA install, and hardware back-button with double-press to exit. No account, no cloud sync, no in-app APK button.
